baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast among the deniers' القول, كفروا, عالم الغيب, and كتاب مبين.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two opposed speech acts are placed across an epistemic reversal: a doctrine that blocks the truth denies arrival, while the counter-oath invokes sovereign knowledge of what is hidden and a record whose contents are manifest. The issue is therefore not two equally grounded predictions but covered assertion versus disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Speech can carry a doctrine or commitment; the doubled root stages rival positions, not neutral reporting.
Blocking or concealing truth supplies the epistemic posture behind the negation.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower counters the deniers' unsupported certainty.
What is screened from created sight names the domain over which the claim is being made.
Manifestness closes the hidden-to-disclosed reversal at the description of the book.

changed_reading.before: A denial of a future event is answered by a contrary prediction.
changed_reading.after: A truth-covering doctrine about the unseen is answered by an oath grounded in exhaustive disclosure and a manifest record.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا يعزب, مثقال ذرة, أصغر, أكبر, and كتاب مبين form one exhaustive construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Absence is excluded, then scale is swept from a particle-weight through smaller and larger, and every item is placed within an obligating record. The distributed speck image and the small/large merism make the book an exhaustive ledger rather than merely a text.

activation_trace.role: Distance, absence, and slipping away supply the excluded failure mode.
A calibrated weight turns total knowledge into exact measurement.
Tiny, dispersed particles test whether distributed minuteness can evade the accounting.
The lower side of magnitude extends the ledger beneath the named particle.
The upper side of magnitude completes the all-scale sweep.
The book as an established, obligating determination gives the measurements durable assignment.
Manifestness makes the ledger's inclusion determinate rather than vague.

changed_reading.before: God knows even very small things.
changed_reading.after: Nothing at any scale or degree of dispersal loses its measured, durable place in an exhaustive ledger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled تأتي, the oath by ربّي, and لا يعزب عنه.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event is first denied as coming to us and then emphatically promised as coming to you. Sovereignty over the whole vertical field and the exclusion of remoteness turn arrival into directed reach: the Hour is not merely dated but reaches its addressees wherever located.

activation_trace.role: Coming as actual arrival makes the repeated change from 'to us' to 'to you' directional and personal.
Lordship as ownership and rule grounds the oath in jurisdiction, not only prediction.
Nothing can become too absent, distant, or missed for the promised arrival to reach it.
What is above and overarching supplies the upper extent of the domain.
The lower field opposite heaven supplies the other spatial extent.

changed_reading.before: The Hour will occur at some future time.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is an emphatically directed arrival that reaches the addressees throughout the Lord's undivided domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah converts the focus ledger from a static list into a live crossing system. Entry and exit through earth and descent and ascent across heaven are inverse channels, so nothing 'being absent' includes every transition between compartments, not only every object at rest.

activation_trace.role: The focus excludes absence or escape, which the context recasts as loss during movement.
Entering into another interior supplies the inward leg of the terrestrial crossing pair.
Passing to the outside supplies the inverse outward leg.
Descent and settling supply downward traffic from the upper domain.
Ascent supplies the return traffic upward.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges four motions as two inverse pairs: into/out of earth and down from/up into heaven, immediately before 34:3's denial of absence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: paired crossings are all objects of divine knowledge; reader arrow: exhaustive knowledge tracks entities through state and boundary changes; live alternative: the pairs may simply enumerate scope without implying a process ledger.

changed_reading.before: Every item is statically present in divine knowledge and record.
changed_reading.after: Every item remains tracked while crossing boundaries and changing location; no transition creates an informational gap.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate purpose clause gives the exhaustive book a judicial function. Deliberate work and deliberate striving to outstrip the signs form opposed action streams, and exact retention enables each action to meet its corresponding outcome.

activation_trace.role: Exact weight supplies the precision required for differentiated response.
An established record can carry an obligating judgment or determination.
Matching a deed with its recompense states the ledger's immediate purpose.
Purposive action identifies what the record evaluates on the favorable side.
Directed movement toward a goal makes opposition to the signs an active course, not a bare opinion.
Trying to outrun or elude pursuit supplies the hostile action's intended escape mechanism.

structural_cues: 34:4 begins with a purposive li- directly after 34:3, and 34:4-5 distribute reward and punishment across opposed courses of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recompense follows the exhaustive record and distinguishes purposeful deeds; reader arrow: the record preserves acts so outcome can correspond exactly; live alternative: the book may include cosmic facts as well as deeds, so adjudication need not exhaust its function.

changed_reading.before: The book proves omniscience and the certainty of the Hour.
changed_reading.after: The exhaustive book is also the operational basis for recompense, retaining even attempted evasions and assigning outcomes to acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mockery of new creation after total tearing activates the focus particle ledger as a continuity mechanism. Dispersal into pieces and possible swallowing by earth do not amount to loss if even the smallest distributed element remains measured and recorded.

activation_trace.role: Minute dispersal supplies the focus-side answer to matter fragmented beyond ordinary recovery.
Durable determination preserves identity or assignment across the proposed disintegration.
Tearing and scattering into pieces states the deniers' physical objection at maximum force.
Bringing creation into being supplies the disputed reconstruction endpoint.
Earth sinking or engulfment adds a second mode by which bodies might seem irrecoverably lost.

structural_cues: 34:7 places complete tearing directly against new creation; 34:9 points to the surrounding heaven and earth as media of engulfment or falling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: complete fragmentation, new creation, and engulfment are explicit; reader arrow: atom-scale retention bridges fragmentation to re-creation; live alternative: the particle ledger may concern deeds and knowledge rather than material reassembly.

changed_reading.before: The particle example only intensifies a claim of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The particle-scale record can answer the disintegration objection: scattering and engulfment never become ontological loss, so new creation remains possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's death remains hidden from the jinn until an earth-crawling creature consumes his support and collapse makes the fact evident. This miniature distinguishes exhaustive divine knowledge from created claims to the unseen and shows how a tiny material process can carry disclosure without making the unseen intrinsically public.

activation_trace.role: Divine knowing is framed as disclosure to the knower.
The hidden-from-eyes domain is precisely what created workers later fail to know.
The tiny distributed image licenses attention to a materially slight disclosure mechanism.
Crawling on earth supplies the small agent whose unnoticed process changes the epistemic scene.
Consumption of the staff supplies the incremental causal process that ends in visible collapse.

structural_cues: 34:14 moves from concealed death through staff consumption and collapse to تبيّنت, then explicitly denies the jinn knowledge of الغيب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a small crawler consumes the support, collapse follows, and the jinn's ignorance of the unseen is exposed; reader arrow: a tiny trace mediates disclosure; live alternative: the episode may contrast kinds of knowers without activating the focus particle image.

changed_reading.before: A clear book might suggest that the hidden is simply transparent to all observers.
changed_reading.after: The hidden is exhaustively clear to God while creatures learn only when a minute material process produces an exposing trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence supplies an enacted branch of kufr: abundant provision calls for acknowledged gratitude, refusal is followed by an arriving flood and replacement of the gardens, and 34:17 names the response as recompense for kufr. The focus deniers' eschatological claim is thus linked to a way of covering received benefit, not only a proposition.

activation_trace.role: The focus initially presents kufr as blocking the truth of arrival.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver states the unfulfilled relational obligation.
The coursing flood materially reverses the stable field of provision.
One set of gardens standing in place of another makes consequence visible as ecological substitution.
Covering a blessing connects the story's refusal of gratitude to the focus label for the deniers.

structural_cues: 34:15-17 runs from edible provision and an imperative to thank, through refusal and landscape replacement, to explicit recompense for kufr.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: gratitude is demanded, refusal precedes flood and substitution, and kufr names the recompensed conduct; reader arrow: the story activates ingratitude inside the focus subject label; live alternative: kufr in 34:17 may retain the broader sense of disbelief without privileging ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Those who kafaru are defined mainly by verbally denying the Hour.
changed_reading.after: Their denial also participates in an embodied economy of ingratitude: received order is covered until consequence reveals what their speech refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact particle-weight formula recurs under a cascade of ownership negations: alleged powers possess none, share none, and provide no supporting force. The focus's exhaustive knowledge therefore doubles as undivided sovereignty; there is no microscopic jurisdiction delegated outside the Lord invoked in the oath.

activation_trace.role: The calibrated particle-weight establishes the focus unit of totality.
The smallest dispersed unit tests whether any residue lies outside divine scope.
Possession and power of disposal are denied even at the focus's minimum unit.
The repeated calibrated weight marks this as a deliberate reuse of the focus formula.
The same tiny dispersed unit now measures the rivals' zero ownership.
Participation or shared title is explicitly excluded across heaven and earth.
Backing and reinforcement are denied after ownership and partnership, closing indirect routes to power.

structural_cues: 34:22 repeats مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض from 34:3, then surrounds it with no ownership, no share, and no helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same particle formula is embedded in exclusive-ownership language; reader arrow: its sovereignty force carries back into the oath by ربّي; live alternative: 34:3 itself foregrounds knowledge, while sovereignty may be a later reuse rather than part of its first sense.

changed_reading.before: Nothing is too small to be known by God.
changed_reading.after: Nothing is small enough to constitute an independent share of ownership, partnership, or supporting power outside God's knowledge and rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated question about the promise is answered with a bounded appointment whose two sides are sealed: it cannot be delayed or advanced even by an hour. The focus's all-scale precision is thereby matched by temporal precision, and 'it will come to you' becomes an appointment rather than an indefinite threat.

activation_trace.role: Actual arrival is the focus claim whose timing the later exchange resolves.
Fine measurement in the focus supplies the precision pattern later applied to time.
An appointment fixes a promise to a time, changing vague futurity into schedule.
A defined span of time supplies the appointed temporal container.
Delay to a later time is explicitly closed as one direction of slippage.
Advancing ahead is closed as the inverse direction of slippage.

structural_cues: 34:29 repeats the challenge 'when is this promise?', and 34:30 answers with paired negations of delay and advance around ساعة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a promised day has neither postponement nor advancement; reader arrow: this exact timing mirrors the focus's exact scale and clarifies the mode of arrival; live alternative: temporal and metric precision may be parallel emphases without one interpreting the other.

changed_reading.before: The Hour's coming is emphatic but temporally unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Its coming is a fixed appointment with no forward or backward temporal leakage, matching the ledger's exactness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The affluent speakers infer immunity from being greater in wealth and children, but the next correction denies that these quantities produce nearness. Against that mismeasurement, the focus's weight and smaller/larger language becomes polemical: exhaustive measurement is not endorsement of the status scale humans use.

activation_trace.role: Weight supplies the image of a true evaluative measure.
Lesser magnitude supplies one side of the scale that human status can misuse.
Greater magnitude supplies the other side without assigning it moral superiority.
Numerical abundance is made the speakers' explicit premise for presumed immunity.
Accumulated wealth supplies the first worldly quantity they mistake for standing.
Descendants supply the second countable asset in the false scale.
Favored nearness is explicitly denied as an automatic product of those assets.

structural_cues: 34:35 states the inference 'more wealth and children, therefore not punished'; 34:37 rejects those assets as what brings anyone near and substitutes faith and fitting action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: worldly abundance is treated as immunity and then denied as a basis of nearness; reader arrow: the focus scale language exposes a rival metric rather than validating size itself; live alternative: smaller/larger in 34:3 may remain purely cosmological.

changed_reading.before: Small and large simply express the range of objects known.
changed_reading.after: The scale also destabilizes human quantity-as-worth: being 'more' in assets does not determine what the exact ledger values.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later sets two projectiles in opposition. The Lord casts stable truth while knowing the unseens; the deniers cast speech toward the unseen from a distant position. This recodes their opening 'the Hour will not come' as a remote verbal projectile lacking access to its target domain.

activation_trace.role: Speech can function as conjecture, allowing the opening negation to be tested for epistemic warrant.
Disclosure to the knower grounds the counterclaim in access rather than distance.
The hidden-from-eyes domain is the target about which the two sides speak.
Forceful casting supplies the Lord-to-world direction of truth's arrival.
Truth as stable correspondence identifies what the warranted cast carries.
Knowledge of plural unseens places the divine cast at the source of the hidden domain.
Throwing words supplies the human act of projecting claims without secure contact.
The unseen is now the object at which their speech is thrown, not a domain they know.
Distance from nearness makes their epistemic remove explicit.

structural_cues: 34:48 pairs casting truth with knowledge of the unseens; 34:53 mirrors the verb but makes people cast at the unseen from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: identical casting language has opposite agents, payloads, and positions; reader arrow: the mirror diagnoses the opening denial as projection rather than knowledge; live alternative: qadhf may mark forceful assertion generally without defining the earlier القول.

changed_reading.before: The deniers offer a skeptical prediction that happens to be false.
changed_reading.after: They launch a verbal guess at a domain from which they are epistemically distant, while the counterclaim proceeds from knowledge and casts truth outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence spatializes the focus exclusion of absence. There is no missed capture; they are seized from near, cannot extend to retrieve faith from far, and a barrier is placed between them and desire. Thus 'nothing escapes Him' is not only cognition but effective reach when the promised arrival closes distance.

activation_trace.role: The promised event comes directly to the addressees, supplying the arrival side of capture.
Absence, distance, and missed reach are the exact possibilities excluded in the focus.
Failure of apprehension or access is explicitly negated at the closing seizure.
Grasping and capture convert non-escape into effective jurisdiction.
Nearness removes the imagined protective distance at the moment of taking.
Extending to reach something supplies the belated retrieval that is no longer available.
The far position explains why their attempted reach cannot close the interval.
An interposed barrier seals the separation between them and what they want.

structural_cues: 34:51 says there is no escape and they are taken from a near place; 34:52 denies reach from a far place; 34:54 ends with a barrier between them and desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: capture, near/far reach, and final separation form an explicit spatial sequence; reader arrow: this sequence carries effective jurisdiction back into لا يعزب and تأتيَنّكم; live alternative: the focus may assert only knowledge while the closing verses separately narrate enforcement.

changed_reading.after: Nothing can use distance, delay, or belated reaching to evade the Hour's effective capture; exhaustive knowledge becomes jurisdictional reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary focus construction means the Hour's coming, while the cited branch is the specialized image of a flood arriving from elsewhere. It remains anchored in the doubled تأتي and the surah's literal flood that replaces a settled landscape. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for boundary-crossing, system-reversing arrival, not as a lexical substitution for الساعة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled تأتي forms read through the branch image of a flood arriving from beyond the locality.

activation_trace.role: An incoming flood from another land gives the promised arrival a cross-boundary material image.
The coursing flood supplies the surah-level event that suddenly enters and overturns a stable order.
Replacement of one garden system by another supplies the irreversible after-state of that arrival.

changed_reading.before: The Hour comes as an abstract future event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its arrival can be imagined like an incoming flood: crossing into a settled domain and replacing its operative order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أصغر and أكبر most directly complete a quantitative merism. It remains anchored through their humiliation/arrogance branches and the later repeated pair of the socially weakened and self-magnifying, whose blame is individually exposed. Downstream prose should mark this as a secondary social resonance, not replace the primary magnitude reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pair أصغر/أكبر, carried through branches of humiliation and self-magnifying arrogance.

activation_trace.role: Smallness as humiliation opens a social-status resonance beneath the primary quantitative comparison.
Greatness as arrogance opens the opposed self-elevating social resonance.
The socially weakened side supplies the lower-status group whose agency and blame are still made visible.
The arrogant side supplies the self-elevated group that cannot remain above the accounting.

changed_reading.before: No physically smaller or larger item is omitted.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, no socially diminished person or self-magnifying leader disappears inside hierarchy; the ledger exposes both positions and their acts.

strongest_changes: 34:2 turns exhaustive knowledge into continuous tracking across inverse earth-heaven crossings.
34:4-5 gives the measured book a recompensive function, while 34:22 reuses the atom formula to deny every share of rival sovereignty.
34:48 and 34:53 distinguish truth cast from knowledge from words thrown remotely at the unseen, diagnosing the opening denial as projection.
34:51-54 turns non-absence into effective no-escape reach through capture, failed retrieval from afar, and final separation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet produced unusually exact internal reprises: the particle-weight formula returns under ownership language, عالم الغيب returns in a truth-casting contrast, and لا يعزب is spatially enacted by the closing near/far capture sequence. The small creature exposing Solomon's hidden death added a distinct created-knowledge limit without collapsing divine clarity into public visibility.
remaining_uncertainties: كتاب مبين may emphasize a deed ledger, an encompassing cosmic register, fixed decree, or several of these functions at once.
The re-creation model depends on carrying particle-scale retention from exhaustive knowledge into material continuity; the packet leaves a deeds-only reading live.
The incoming-flood and social small/great activations are branch-supported analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
